descriptionPlain:
About SuperAnnotate

SuperAnnotate helps the world’s leading AI teams build responsible, next-generation models powered by high-quality human data. We’re a fast-growing Series B startup bridging the gap between advanced AI innovation and the data that drives it. Our global network of expert specialists, scalable managed operations, precise talent matching, and full project transparency ensure unmatched data quality at scale. Trusted by innovators like Databricks and ServiceNow - and backed by NVIDIA, Dell Technologies Capital, Databricks Ventures, Cox Enterprises, and Lionel Messi’s Play Time VC - SuperAnnotate is proud to be the top-ranked AI data company on G2 for multiple consecutive years, including 2025.


The Impact You'll Make
As Director of Operations, you will serve as a key operational leader responsible for managing and improving the company’s day-to-day operations during a period of rapid growth and increasing organizational complexity. Reporting directly to the COO, you’ll work across teams to improve coordination, drive accountability, and ensure operational processes run effectively across the business.
This is a highly hands-on role focused on operational execution, process management, and cross-functional support. You’ll oversee critical operational functions spanning Finance and Accounting, IT, Information Security, Sales Operations and RevOps (including CRM and sales enablement), Facilities, and operational support related to legal and commercial processes.
You’ll lead and support a growing operations team while helping establish the structure, workflows, and communication processes needed for teams to operate efficiently in a fast-moving environment.
This is a high-visibility opportunity for an experienced operator who thrives in lean, high-growth environments and enjoys building scalable processes that directly impact company performance.
This is a full-time, hybrid position based in San Francisco.

lists.content:
• Partner closely with executive leadership to improve operational execution, accountability and organizational scale

  • Oversee day-to-day business operations across multiple cross-functional areas including business operations, finance and accounting, tech support, IT, InfoSec and facilities

  • Build and improve scalable operational processes, workflows, and accountability systems across the organization

  • Support operational coordination tied to contracts, legal processes, commercial operations, and cross-functional execution

  • Own and administer core sales operations and RevOps systems, including CRM (HubSpot) and sales engagement tools, and support sales enablement initiatives.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary global operations team, including managers and individual contributors

  • Drive organizational prioritization and improve operational efficiency in a lean, fast-moving environment

  • Partner with leadership to support aggressive company growth targets and evolving business needs

  • Use data and operational insights to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve business performance

  • Help establish clear operational structure and communication processes that enable teams to execute effectively in a fast-paced environment

• 7+ years of operations, business operations, revenue operations, strategy & finance, or related operational leadership experience

  • Prior experience managing teams and developing people leaders (this is not a first-time manager role)

  • Strong operational leadership experience in high-growth or fast-paced environments

  • Experience supporting or owning operational processes related to RevOps, Sales Ops, commercial operations and commercial contract reviews

  • Working knowledge of accounting and finance fundamentals, sufficient to directly manage and mentor finance/accounting staff

  • Proven ability to independently manage day-to-day operations while balancing strategic priorities

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills

  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building structure in evolving environments

  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and operational judgment

  • Experience leading operational improvements and scaling processes across teams

• Experience working in technology companies (preferably AI, AdTech, FinTech or data services), SaaS environments, or operationally complex businesses

  • Experience working in lean organizations with broad ownership and hands-on responsibilities

  • Exposure to accounting/finance operations (close process, AP/AR, financial reporting) in an early-stage or startup environment

  • Experience supporting operational scale and process improvement across growing teams

lists.content:
• Develop pipeline using demand generation, prospecting tools, professional networking, and enterprise selling methodology

  • Build account plans and manage a territory of target enterprises training and deploying frontier AI models

  • Explore & identify new opportunities in new accounts and expansion of existing accounts, including new use cases, data types, and modalities within current customers

  • Research and present business intelligence about customers' and prospects' model development roadmaps, data needs, and where human data services fit into their pipeline

  • Scope and shape services engagements, including specialized labeling workforces, data pipelines, and project structures aligned to customer model needs

  • Help develop and continuously improve our prospecting and selling motions

  • Own deals from prospect to close, and maintain relationship with delivery/customer success through renewals and expansions

• 5+ years of experience selling and generating demand for enterprise services, with strong preference for candidates who have sold data services, managed services, or professional services into AI/ML buyers

  • Experience and relationships selling to executives and teams training frontier AI models at organizations such as Google, Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic, Apple, Meta, etc.

  • Previous experience selling into AI/ML, data labeling, data annotation, RLHF, or related human-data services required

  • Comfort selling complex, high-touch services deals where pricing, scope, and delivery model are negotiated and customized per account, rather than a standard licensing motion

  • High business acumen and ability to sell technology and business value to all levels of an organization including individual contributors, mid-level management, and C-level executives

  • Experience with MEDDICC and enterprise selling methodologies such as Command of the Message

  • Consistent track record of exceeding quota

  • Strong ability to succeed in multi-channel pipeline generation including inbound discovery calls, outbound prospecting, working with SDRs and working with partners

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, creative, and incredibly resourceful

  • Self-starter and independent worker, ambitious and takes initiative

  • An attentive listener, quick study, and skilled influencer

  • Strong customer presence, with polish and dedication to customer outcomes

  • Ability to travel occasionally to meet customers and attend industry events

• Attractive base salary with significant stock options offering an ownership stake in the company's success

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Flexible paid time off, holidays, and parental leave policies

  • Opportunity to shape the future of a cutting-edge technology company

  • Access to ongoing training and professional development opportunities

  • Referral Program

descriptionPlain:
About SuperAnnotate

SuperAnnotate helps the world’s leading AI teams build responsible, next-generation models powered by high-quality human data. We’re a fast-growing Series B startup bridging the gap between advanced AI innovation and the data that drives it. Our global network of expert specialists, scalable managed operations, precise talent matching, and full project transparency ensure unmatched data quality at scale. Trusted by innovators like Databricks and ServiceNow - and backed by NVIDIA, Dell Technologies Capital, Databricks Ventures, Cox Enterprises, and Lionel Messi’s Play Time VC - SuperAnnotate is proud to be the top-ranked AI data company on G2 for multiple consecutive years, including 2025.


The Impact You'll Make
We’re looking for a skilled operator who can take full ownership of our most complex, high-value client engagements.
As a Strategic Projects Lead, you’ll run the end-to-end delivery of SuperAnnotate’s largest LLM and Gen AI data programs. This includes everything from scoping data collection workflows with key clients, acting as a trusted resource to researchers, resolving a quality issue, reallocating resources under a tight deadline, and more. The role touches everything: strategy, execution, client relationships, team development, and process design.
You’ll work directly with researchers, data teams, and other key stakeholders at some of the most advanced AI organizations in the world. You’ll be trusted to represent SuperAnnotate at the highest level - and to grow those relationships through execution and management excellence.
You don't need to be building models — but you do need to be technical enough to understand how they're trained, evaluated, and improved. That means hands-on comfort with data, code, and pipelines, and the ability to engage credibly with client engineering and research teams on LLM data challenges and evaluation approaches.
This is a full-time, hybrid position based in San Francisco.

About SuperAnnotate

SuperAnnotate helps the world’s leading AI teams build responsible, next-generation models powered by high-quality human data. Trusted by innovators like Databricks and ServiceNow - and backed by NVIDIA, Dell Technologies Capital, Databricks Ventures, Cox Enterprises, and Lionel Messi’s Play Time VC - SuperAnnotate is proud to be the top-ranked AI data company on G2 for multiple consecutive years, including 2025.

The Impact You'll Make

We’re looking for a skilled, technical operator who can take full ownership of our most complex, high-value client engagements.

As a Strategic Projects Lead, you’ll run the end-to-end delivery of SuperAnnotate’s largest LLM and Gen AI data programs. This includes everything from scoping data collection workflows with key clients, acting as a trusted resource to researchers, diagnosing data quality issues, and reallocating resources under a tight deadline. The role touches everything: strategy, execution, client relationships, team development, and process design.

You’ll work directly with researchers, data teams, and other key stakeholders at some of the most advanced AI organizations in the world. You'll be trusted to represent SuperAnnotate at the highest level, including on technical tradeoffs, and to grow those relationships through execution and management excellence.

You don't need to be building models, but you do need to be technical enough to understand how they're trained, evaluated, and improved. That means hands-on comfort with data, code, and pipelines, and the ability to engage credibly with client engineering and research teams on LLM data challenges and evaluation approaches.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in San Francisco.

lists.content:
• Own project delivery end-to-end: Lead LLM and Gen AI data engagements from initial scoping through final delivery - including use case definition, resource planning, quality oversight, and client sign-off. The project succeeds or fails on your watch.
  • Be the client’s main point of contact: Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders. Bring transparency, good judgment, and a solutions orientation to every interaction.
  • Drive operational discipline across workstreams: Manage timelines, staffing plans, and delivery quality across multiple concurrent projects. Catch problems before they become crises and fix them before they reach the client.
  • Design and build the systems that make delivery possible: Architect data pipelines, quality frameworks, and review infrastructure that let your team execute at scale. Instrument the right KPIs, catch regressions early, and continuously refine processes as program needs evolve.
  • Lead and develop your team: Recruit, mentor, and performance-manage the operations and subject matter experts. Set the bar, support the people, and build toward a team that can scale.
  • Identify scope expansion opportunities: Partner with Go-to-Market to turn strong delivery into expanded engagements. Understand your clients’ broader AI data challenges well enough to propose what’s next.
  • Keep leadership and clients informed: Develop reporting cadences and executive briefings that give an honest, clear picture of project health, risks, and outcomes.

• 4+ years of experience running complex technical projects or operations in client-facing roles, with at least some of that time in a high-growth startup environment.

  • A track record of owning outcomes: You’ve managed cross-functional workstreams with real accountability - and you can point to what you delivered and how.

  • Coding ability and analytical depth: You have solid coding skills (Python, SQL, or similar) alongside depth in machine learning, statistics, or data science.

  • Strong senior stakeholder communication: You’re comfortable in a room with a CTO or VP and can represent a complex project clearly, confidently, and honestly.

  • Sharp operational problem-solving: You diagnose issues structurally, propose solutions with clear tradeoffs, and move quickly from analysis to action.

  • Financial and resource fluency: You understand project margins, can build resource plans, and think about the business impact of operational decisions.

  • A working knowledge of the Gen AI landscape: Familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated, and what drives data quality at each stage, so you can guide your team’s approach and speak knowledgeably with client research teams.

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Statistics, Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. CS, Math, and Engineering degrees should include meaningful ML or applied data science exposure.

• Experience building or managing large distributed contributor or expert workforces.

  • Background in management consulting, investment banking, or data-intensive technical services.

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

descriptionPlain:
About SuperAnnotate

SuperAnnotate is a fast-growing, Series B startup revolutionizing the field of AI-data Infrastructure. We specialize in providing cutting-edge data pipeline solutions for Machine Learning, LLM, and GenAI solutions to large enterprise clients, helping them leverage the power of AI to transform their businesses. SuperAnnotate has a fully customizable platform for building annotation tools and workflows that AI projects demand—while unifying the management of all teams, vendors, and data in one place. We’re very proud to have products that are loved by our customers, resulting in us being listed as the highest-ranked platform on G2.


Role
 
Our team is seeking a Mid-level Test Engineer to help ensure the success of our API and Enterprise applications and services by automating the testing process using modern testing methodologies and tools. The ideal candidate will advocate for QA best practices while delivering top-notch products that offer an exceptional user experience.
 
Your Day
 
Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
Perform manual testing to identify and report bugs, ensuring that the application meets requirements and acceptance criteria.
Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Python, Selenium, and pytest.
Implement and manage the Page Object Model (POM) for scalable and maintainable test automation.
Develop API automation tests to ensure the robustness and reliability of backend services.
Conduct exploratory testing to uncover potential issues that automated tests might miss.
Collaborate with product owners, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
Work with DevOps to enhance continuous integration processes.
Execute automated tests, analyze results, and report defects with clear and concise descriptions.
Monitor test results and provide feedback to the development team for immediate resolution.
Maintain up-to-date documentation of test cases, test scripts, and test results.


What is needed to get started
 
3+ years of experience as a QA Engineer
Experience with Python, Selenium, and API testing
Experience with AI tools is a plus
Good understanding of POM
Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes
Understanding of agile processes from a quality perspective
Good communication skills in English and Armenian
